Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.Statement:University X has extended the date for submission of applications for admission to post-graduate courses by a month. Applications can now be submitted up to 31st August 2024.Possible Reasons:I. Many students had complained to the Vice Chancellor of University X that they were unable to submit the application online due to software issues with the University webpage.II. University X has issued a notification regarding the students who will not be eligible to appear for semester exams due to the lack of attendance.

Both I and II are possible reasons.
